display.title: Episode 445: The Strange Beggar, Chapter 3 (Erev Rosh Hashanah)
display.summary_short: On the eve of Rosh Hashanah 5751, Uncle Yossi explains crowning Hashem as King and Tashlich, and the strange beggar story comes to its surprising end.
display.summary_long: Broadcast two days before Rosh Hashanah 5751. Uncle Yossi explains that Rosh Hashanah is the world's birthday: Hashem renews the world and our neshamah each year, and just as Adam proclaimed Hashem King, we crown Him with the prayers of the machzor and the sounding of the shofar. He urges everyone to be in shul on time for the shofar. After the Hakochainik march, he teaches that teshuvah, tefillah and tzedakah avert a harsh decree, and everyone gives tzedakah. A first-grade class from a Brooklyn girls' school recites the Shema. Story time concludes 'The Strange Beggar': the town throws a lavish banquet for its new rabbi, who puts the fish and soup into his pockets and smears dessert on his new suit. Then he puts on the beggar's coat they had turned away, and explains that they were honoring his clothes, not him. The townspeople apologize and resolve to improve. Uncle Yossi closes by explaining Tashlich with the example of paper thrown into flowing water, and wishes everyone a good and sweet year.
display.lesson: Honor people for who they are, not for their clothes; welcome guests and give tzedakah generously.
